notes.title: Strawberry Vinegar Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just to let you know, I uploaded a new build of Strawberry Vinegar. This update changed a few things, including:


 slightly edited/updated UI
 a complete rework of the CG gallery code
 updated sound effects
 some small edits to the text (mostly rewording the odd sentence here and there I thought was awkward/stilted)
 and the sprites have blinking animations now. Amazing!!!


I also compressed the sprites a bit, so now they take up less space. The game is about 500MB smaller because of it, so it should be quicker to download!

These are all rather minor changes all around, but hopefully it adds some polish to this rather old release and brings it more in-line quality-wise with my newer releases.

If you find any problems with the new build, such as achievements refusing to trigger, typos, or graphical bugs, please feel free to tell me.

Thank you for your continued support! It's appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: Strawberry Vinegar update
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Just letting everyone know that I recently released an update for this VN.

In this update, I...

1) Fixed a lot of typos and grammatical errors, as pointed out to me by a helpful proofreader
2) Edited a handful of scenes to make them 'flow' a bit better
3) Edited the animated fireworks effect, so it should no longer cause eye strain
4) Updated the game to the newest build of Ren'py, which should help it run more smoothly. Maybe?
[strike]Well, the conversion certainly broke a bunch of my old code, which meant I had to redo it. Let's hope it was not in vain.[/strike]

If you find any more typos/bugs in this new build, be sure to let me know! I appreciate all your feedback!

- ebi x

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hi guys! ///

I updated the build of SV to fix some spelling errors (finally...) These were pointed out a while ago, so I guess it's a bit bad I only got around to doing it now... But better late than never, I suppose...?

In addition, I also added an option to change the textbox in the game. I got a few comments from people saying the textbox was too pale and it was hard to read the white text against it, so now there are five (a whole five!) different textboxes to choose from.

I also updated ren'py to the newest version to create this build, so I'm a bit concerned saves may no longer be compatible across versions... I don't think there is anything I can do about it, but please let me know if your saves work or not.

Thank you!

- Ebi xxx
